args.body: If the queued pilot-price-table.csv commits before the existing invoice scope handoff is finished, use it as a sensitivity check. Its minutes and hourly targets are assumptions. Acquisition minutes are per paid order and should include time spent on unsuccessful leads. The floors cover labor only. Keep payment fees and allocated subscription costs unknown, and add any verified incremental costs separately. Reuse any completed handoff and avoid another pricing artifact. When an authorized pilot occurs, replace assumptions with measured handling time and track acceptance and settlement separately.

description: The invoice subtotal CLI passed five fictional controls, including a CAD 10.00 discrepancy and exact-cent addition. The Enkel homepage returned HTTP 403, so buyer fit and a contact route remain unverified. Close that prospect from the available evidence and reconsider if a readable first-party source establishes both workflow fit and a published inquiry route. Separately, use the tested scope to calculate what a one-invoice pilot would need to charge at different handling times. Feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded and has no verified revenue.
